```{python}
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".")

import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import yaml
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from utils.helpers import load_processed_data

with open("_params.yml") as f:
    params = yaml.safe_load(f)

st_dict = load_processed_data(params)

# Compute morphological features for each method
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    st.bl.morphological_features(n_jobs=4)
    print(f"{method}: morphological features computed")
```

## Overview

Morphological features describe the shape and size of segmented cells.
Differences between methods reflect their underlying segmentation strategies:
Xenium uses nuclear expansion, while Proseg v3 infers cell boundaries
from transcript positions.

## Cell area and perimeter

```{python}
features = ["cell_area", "perimeter"]

dfs = []
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    obs = st.sdata.tables["table"].obs.copy()
    obs["method"] = method
    dfs.append(obs[["method"] + features])

df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))

for ax, feat in zip(axes, features):
    cap = df_all[feat].quantile(0.99)
    sns.violinplot(
        data=df_all[df_all[feat] <= cap],
        x="method", y=feat,
        palette="Set2", ax=ax
    )
    ax.set_title(feat.replace("_", " ").capitalize())
    ax.set_xlabel("")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Shape descriptors

```{python}
shape_features = ["circularity", "solidity", "convexity", "elongation", "eccentricity"]

dfs = []
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    obs = st.sdata.tables["table"].obs.copy()
    obs["method"] = method
    dfs.append(obs[["method"] + shape_features])

df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(shape_features), figsize=(4 * len(shape_features), 4))

for ax, feat in zip(axes, shape_features):
    sns.kdeplot(
        data=df_all,
        x=feat,
        hue="method",
        palette="Set2",
        common_norm=False,
        fill=False,
        ax=ax
    )
    ax.set_title(feat.replace("_", " ").capitalize())
    ax.set_xlabel("")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Summary table

```{python}
morph_features = [
    "cell_area", "perimeter", "circularity", "solidity",
    "convexity", "elongation", "eccentricity", "compactness", "extent"
]

rows = []
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    obs = st.sdata.tables["table"].obs
    row = {"Method": method}
    for feat in morph_features:
        if feat in obs.columns:
            row[f"{feat} (mean)"] = round(obs[feat].mean(), 3)
            row[f"{feat} (median)"] = round(obs[feat].median(), 3)
    rows.append(row)

pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("Method").T
```
